meta.title: Devil's Gate | Puerta del Diablo
meta.description: Explore Devil's Gate (Puerta del Diablo) in Panchimalco, El Salvador. A beautiful park with spectacular natural scenery and hiking trails.

intro.title: Explore Devil's Gate
intro.description: Devil's Gate (Puerta del Diablo) is located in Panchimalco, San Salvador Department, El Salvador. It is a beautiful park with spectacular mountain views and rich natural landscapes, making it one of the most popular tourist attractions in El Salvador.

visitGuide.title: Visiting Tips
items: Bring a camera to capture spectacular mountain views
Carry enough water and sun protection

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: Spectacular mountain views: Overlook the entire Panchimalco and surrounding beautiful scenery.
Nature trails: Multiple hiking trails suitable for hiking enthusiasts.
Cool climate: High altitude with cool and pleasant climate.
Prime location: Located in Panchimalco with convenient access.

route.title: Tour Route
route.overview: Discover the ideal route to explore Devil's Gate and experience the essence of natural scenery and Salvadoran culture.
steps: Start from the entrance and climb up along the main trail.
Stop at the viewpoint to enjoy spectacular mountain views and panoramic scenery.
Continue exploring the surrounding nature trails and feel the fresh mountain air.
Rest at the park's rest area and enjoy the tranquility of nature.
supplements: It's recommended to go in the morning to avoid crowds and enjoy fresh air.
Pay attention to sun protection as UV rays are stronger at high altitudes.
Please take your trash with you to protect the natural environment.

knowledge.title: Discover the Charm of Devil's Gate

sections.title: Historical Significance
sections.content: Devil's Gate is an important natural landmark in El Salvador and has long been a favorite leisure place for local residents and tourists.

sections.title: Natural Landscape
sections.content: It features spectacular mountain views and rich vegetation, making it an excellent place to experience the natural beauty of El Salvador.

sections.title: Visiting Experience
sections.content: Strolling through Devil's Gate, feeling the cool mountain climate and magnificent natural scenery, is an unforgettable nature experience.

hours.summerTime: Pleasant weather, ideal for outdoor visits
hours.winterTime: Warm weather with afternoon rains, bring umbrella
hours.warningTime: Recommended to verify latest information before visiting
hours.tip: Daytime visits offer the best experience

transport.title: Transportation
transport.airportDesc: Nearest airport: El Salvador International Airport (SAL). From there, take a bus or taxi to Panchimalco.
transport.selfDriveDesc: The park is located in Panchimalco. Use navigation and check for parking nearby.
transport.busDesc: You can take public transport to Panchimalco, then walk or take a taxi to the park.
transport.intercityDesc: There are walking trails in the park, walkable to various attractions.
transport.cyclingDesc: Public transport or driving recommended, convenient transportation around the park.
transport.tipsDesc: Devil's Gate is an excellent place to experience El Salvador's natural scenery, daytime visits recommended.

historyTimeline.title: Historical Timeline

items.title: Early Period: Natural Formation
items.description: Devil's Gate is a naturally formed spectacular mountain view that has long been a favorite place for local residents.

items.title: 20th Century: Tourism Development
items.description: With the development of tourism in El Salvador, Devil's Gate gradually became a popular tourist attraction with continuously improving facilities.

items.title: 21st Century: Ecotourism Destination
items.description: In the 21st century, Devil's Gate attracts more and more visitors with its spectacular natural scenery, becoming an important window to experience El Salvador's ecotourism.

historyTimeline.guideContent: When visiting, you can start from the **entrance** to feel the natural atmosphere; then enjoy the spectacular mountain views at the **viewpoint**; next, explore the **nature trails** to feel the fresh mountain air; finally, rest at the **rest area** to deeply understand the important position of these natural landscapes in El Salvador's natural culture.
